title: Design System: Vietnamese Gospel Outreach Ministry New England

display.purpose: Hero and page titles; Playfair 700, fluid clamp size.

body.purpose: Geist sans; minimum 16px on marketing blocks; 1.75 line-height.

shadows.name: elevation-card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for every card. Two layers: tight contact shadow plus wide ambient. Dark mode uses near-black at high alpha because ink-tinted low-alpha is invisible on #141210.

shadows.name: elevation-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover elevation for interactive cards only, paired with translateY(-3px). Must be raised alongside elevation-card: the effect is carried by the gap between the two levels, not by either value alone.

motion.name: ease-page-entry
motion.purpose: PageTransition fade and card lift; disabled when prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: card-lift-distance
motion.purpose: How far a card rises on hover. Small on purpose: the shadow carries the effect, the travel only confirms it.

motion.name: duration-card-lift
motion.purpose: Faster on approach than on release, so the rise reads as a reaction and the settle as the card relaxing back down.

components.name: Primary button (on dark hero)
components.description: Terracotta fill, warm paper label; used for primary hero CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-hero-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; background: #c4663c; color: #fffefb; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; text-decoration: none; transition: filter 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-hero-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-hero-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5f0eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost button (on dark hero)
components.description: Outline cream, transparent fill; secondary hero CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-hero-ghost { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 240, 235, 0.85); background: transparent; color: #f5f0eb; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-hero-ghost:hover { background: rgba(245, 240, 235, 0.1); } .ds-btn-hero-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5f0eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 760px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid #eae5de; background: #fffefb; color: #1c1a18; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(28, 20, 16, 0.07), 0 6px 16px -3px rgba(28, 20, 16, 0.11); transition: box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(28, 20, 16, 0.08), 0 16px 36px -6px rgba(28, 20, 16, 0.17); transform: translateY(-3px); transition-duration: 200ms; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card { transition: none; } .ds-card:hover { transform: none; } } .ds-card-inner { padding: 20px; } .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(196, 102, 60, 0.12); color: #c4663c; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Georgia, 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin: 8px 0 4px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.75; color: #6b6560; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: This system is built for members glancing at phones and laptops at home after work, or catching up on Sunday between services: warm cream fields, terracotta as the single confident accent for action, and sage only where a second voice is needed (events, admin hints). Darkness lives in the hero band only (#1C1210), like a quiet coffee shop interior, not a full-site dark theme. Typography does the identity work: Playfair carries headlines and card titles; Geist carries UI, body, and labels.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream (#faf7f2) page field; ink (#1c1a18) body copy; terracotta (#c4663c) for all primary interactive emphasis.
Hero is type-only (no photography): radial terracotta glow + thin terracotta-to-gold rule at the foot of the hero.
Cards float, everything else is flat: cards carry a resting shadow and rise 3px on hover; panels, alerts, and section blocks never cast one.
System prefers-color-scheme: dark uses warm charcoal surfaces, never blue-gray chrome.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only hue that may signal click here or primary navigation emphasis. If a control reads as interactive, it must not be navy, gray, or cold blue.

rules.name: The Gold Is Silent Rule
rules.body: #c49a3c may ornament lines and marks; it does not run buttons, links, or chips.

rules.name: The Serif Owns Headlines Rule
rules.body: Any element that is a page title, section title, or card title uses Playfair. UI chrome and buttons stay Geist, and UI sans does not use weight 700 for body-scale copy.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Rule
rules.body: There are only two heights in this system: cards, and the page they sit on. Nothing nests a third. If a surface is not a card, it does not cast a shadow, and a card never contains another card.

rules.name: The Lift Confirms Rule
rules.body: Hover elevation is reserved for surfaces that actually do something when clicked. A panel that rises under the cursor but does nothing is a lie about its affordance - static panels use .card-rest, interactive cards use .card-lift.

dos: Do keep page background cream (#faf7f2) and body text warm ink (#1c1a18).
Do use Playfair for every headline-level title and Geist for nav, forms, and buttons.
Do reserve gold for decorative lines and marks, not CTAs.
Do separate major home sections with vertical space, not alternating background colors.
Do honor reduced motion by disabling the page-entry fade when the user prefers reduced motion.
donts: Don't use navy blue anywhere; it is the retired palette (PRODUCT Hard Avoids).
Don't use pure #000000 or #ffffff as full-page backgrounds; tint neutrals toward warmth.
Don't use cool gray borders; borders stay warm bisque (#eae5de).
Don't put blue on any interactive element; failure condition per PRODUCT.
Don't add section background color changes just to separate blocks; use space.
Don't use gradients except the hero radial glow and hero bottom rule (PRODUCT).
Don't use glassmorphism (decorative blur panels) as the default chrome; the nav is opaque warm field.
Don't use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk (PRODUCT).
Don't ship layouts that look like a generic church template, AI-generated nonprofit site, or SaaS hero strip (PRODUCT Anti-Generic Directive).
Don't use decorative blobs, gradient meshes, or floating shapes behind content (PRODUCT).
